name: jip38-observatory
description: An independent, chain-derived record of whether Jito does what JIP-38 says it will do: 80% of JTX platform fees to JTO buybacks and permanent burns.
//dependencies: There are none, and that is deliberate rather than an oversight.
This project's argument is that a reader can audit it end to end: take the
addresses out of REGISTRY.tsv, look at them yourself, and rebuild every
figure from the scripts here. Every dependency is a piece of that argument
a reader has to take on trust instead, and a supply-chain surface on a
machine that holds an RPC credential.
Base58, the Metaplex layout, the token bucket, the static server and the
content policy are all small enough to write and test in the open. Where a
library would genuinely be better — schema validation, for one — the
